notes.text: Need a way to delete/remove "kept" generic characters from the roster.
Tokens of preloaded characters who are not yet present in the scene should appear in a box _above_ the "Catalog/Generic/Memoriam" buttons, so they are available regardless of the tab I'm on.
Need a way to add unsorted cataloged NPCs to groups via the Dashboard

There is often a moment of audio that plays at full volume at the beginning of a scene transition, before being set to zero. I know emitters are silenced as part of the build process, but I suspect we need to set the volumes to zero before we activate them to prevent this.
